statement.description: One PartiQL SELECT, such as SELECT * FROM "orders" WHERE customer_id = ?. Without a key condition DynamoDB reads the whole table.

parameters.description: Values of the statement's ? placeholders, in order, as DynamoDB typed values such as {"S": "c-42"}.

limit.description: Most items to return; the endpoint caps it.

cursor.description: nextCursor of the previous answer; leave it out for the first page.
